race.description: Flying Horse Bar & Brewery Mdn Plate
race.comment: MR SIOUX (3) looks the one to beat and has been backed accordingly early. He debuted in a deeper maiden than this at Bendigo and ran a very good race to be beaten under a length into second. He draws barrier one here, if he can settle closer he'll be very hard to hold out. JUST MY LOT (8) resumed with a solid run at Hamilton on bottomless ground as a $2.80 chance. She should be fitter now and takes catching. ALL MOONLITE (7) resumes having run a sound race on debut at Bendigo, a stronger maiden than this. Off a very long spell here is the worry, watch the market. TEMPERED EDGE (6) struggled second up but had been good fresh and can improve.
